_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the source-file-size hard limit. Each entry needs an exact maxLines, a rationale, an owner, and a kind. Temporary debt (kind "other") also needs an issue or reviewBy date. See .pi/skills/aikami-conventions/SKILL.md. Remove exceptions as files shrink; the guard fails on obsolete entries.

packages/shared/constants/src/lib/countr.rationale: Cohesive ISO-3166 country/region table: one nested literal per country, consumed as a single lookup dataset. Splitting it would scatter one data structure across files without creating a responsibility boundary.

packages/shared/constants/src/lib/locale.rationale: Cohesive locale registry (one record per locale) consumed as a single lookup table. It is declarative data with no logic; file boundaries would add imports, not cohesion.

packages/shared/lpc/src/lib/legacy_catal.rationale: Generated legacy LPC catalog ordering snapshot (DO NOT hand-edit; regenerated from the test fixture and kept in parity by a test). A single frozen data structure that must not be split because legacy appearance indices depend on its exact order.

packages/shared/utils/src/lib/form/weak_.rationale: Cohesive static password blocklist (top 10000 common passwords, filtered). It is a single reference dataset with no logic; splitting adds imports without creating a responsibility boundary.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/ga.rationale: One cohesive session-lifecycle service (sessions, recaps, checkpoint CRUD, fork, context compaction). A review-mandated compensating fork saga grew it 21 lines past its grandfathered baseline; the saga and its rollback belong with the checkpoint transitions it guards, so the growth is accepted rather than split across files.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/views/dev/o.rationale: Fixture-driven design-sandbox ViewModel (Phase 1). It reached main at 809 lines via the #327 squash while the PR head measured 800; main's push-to-main guard run does not re-scan unchanged files, so the oversize surfaced only on the next apps-touching PR. Reviewed so this provenance PR can land; the sandbox is dev-only and slated for removal once the design is proven.

scripts/src/lib/agents/contract_pipeline.rationale: Grew on main in e8080d511 ("fix: contract pipeline"), which changed this file but did not re-run guard_source_file_size. Main's push-to-main run has an empty affected set, so it never re-scans and the oversize surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR (C-511). Accepted so that PR can land. This is the pipeline's public surface: every exported stage entry point and its shared run context live here.

Grew on main in e8080d511 ("fix: contract pipeline"), which changed this file but did not re-run guard_source_file_size. Main's push-to-main run has an empty affected set, so it never re-scans and the oversize surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR (C-511). Accepted so that PR can land. The stage state machine (planning -> implement -> verify -> review -> reconcile). All stages share one mutable run context and transition table, so splitting it would spread a single state machine across files without creating a boundary.

scripts/src/lib/herdr/session.ts.rationale: C-513: contract-ID resolution for a restored herdr pane. `CONTRACT_PIPELINE_CONTRACT_PATH` is injected per stage via `tab create --env`, but a pane restored after a daemon restart (or relaunched from the pane's shell) comes back without it, so `currentContractId()` fell back to undefined and `herdr_session`/`herdr:start` dropped dev services into the shared `aikami-emulator` workspace instead of the contract's own. The fix derives the id from the worktree path and keeps the env as the primary source. Grew 2279 -> 2299 on main in 76fdbbaf2, whose push-to-main run resolves 0 targets (`moon ci --base=origin/main` diffs main against itself), so this repo-wide guard never re-scanned it and the stale ceiling surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR. Raises the reviewed ceiling, not the hard limit; owner review by the reviewBy date.

scripts/src/lib/herdr/worktree.ts.rationale: Grew on main in e8080d511 ("fix: contract pipeline"), which changed this file but did not re-run guard_source_file_size. Main's push-to-main run has an empty affected set, so it never re-scans and the oversize surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR (C-511). Accepted so that PR can land. herdr worktree lifecycle (create/checkpoint/reconcile/teardown); these paths mutate one worktree registry and must stay ordered together.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/ga.rationale: C-516 replaced the hardcoded `[1, 2]`/60-HP combat start with a real engine start: `startCombat` now carries an authored roster, a deterministic seed and the pinned engine, and dispatches `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` only after the combat overlay activates (with `COMBAT_START_REJECTED` closing it again). This service already owns every overlay-stack transition, so the encounter-start contract belongs with them instead of in a second overlay service. Grew +39 over the grandfathered 1452. Named follow-up: extract the combat overlay lifecycle from the management overlays.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/views/comba.rationale: C-516 direct control: preview requests bound to state revision, move/ability/target selection, combat-move-mode publication, live-state replay, catalog-derived ability and button projections, typed rejection feedback, and canvas move intents. Revision changes now invalidate outstanding previews, while combat logs update their actual initiative target without overwriting the primary enemy. This is the single combat interaction surface on `/game`, so the sidebar interaction model lands in one place. Grew +529 over the grandfathered 1801 — the largest remaining debt after C-516, and the named follow-up: split selection/preview out of the ViewModel.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/views/game/.rationale: +20: combat ViewModel lifecycle on `/game`. The overlay mounts the combat ViewModel optimistically before the engine answers, and it must survive the engine's own `COMBAT_STARTED` — a torn-down ViewModel silently dropped every turn and budget event, leaving a fight with no tracker.

packages/frontend/engine/src/game_world..rationale: +19: the main-thread `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` forwarder, `COMBAT_MOVE_MODE` gate and lifecycle reset, and canvas move-intent bridge back to the selection owner. They are registered here because the worker cannot see a UI selection, and GameWorld is already the single owner of bridge-command registration. Without them the worker's encounter handler was unreachable or pointer moves could bypass preview validation and leave move mode active.

packages/frontend/engine/src/systems/tur.rationale: +2: the legacy turn manager now stands down for an encounter pinned to the v2 resolver. The pin is read from the encounter, never from the feature flag, so a mid-fight config change cannot move an encounter between engines.

packages/frontend/engine/src/types.ts.rationale: +29: the C-516 wire additions — the `COMBAT_MOVE_MODE` and `COMBAT_START_REJECTED` commands, the `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` envelope, and the additive `engine` / `playerEntityId` / `encounterId` / `stateRevision` event fields. This file is the single `GameCommand`/`GameEvent` union and the repo's documented home for cross-boundary wire types, so additives have nowhere else to go.

packages/frontend/engine/src/worker/ecs_.rationale: +129: the worker's `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` handler (validation before any spawn, roster materialisation, engine pin, typed rejection plus legacy fallback), `COMBAT_MOVE`, `COMBAT_SYNC_REQUEST`, and engine-routed preview/action dispatch. The worker owns its own command switch, and the combat cases read the same world/state locals as the rest of it. Named follow-up: extract the combat cases into a combat worker module.

scripts/src/lib/agents/contract_pipeline.rationale: C-513: worker tool allowlists now resolve to literal tool names. `--tools` is a tool-name allowlist, but the adapter passed `resolveEnabledExtensions` keys (`herdr_orchestrator`, `contract_factory`), which were silently dropped — a worker could start without ever being able to call `contract_stage complete`. the fix imports `resolveEnabledTools` from `.pi/extensions/lib/role_profiles.ts`, which expands extension keys into their registered tool names. Grew 1539 -> 1545 on main in 76fdbbaf2; the guard never re-scanned it there (0 resolved targets on push-to-main). Converted from the grandfathered baseline entry to an exception because raising a baseline entry is rejected as unauthorized expansion against the base ref, which is the guard's documented remedy for exactly this diagnostic.
